description: Required architecture functionality rows. Failing rows remain required gaps; comparison rows are backed by real targets.

phases.title: Content-addressed toy cutoff on an ssh-ng remote builder
phases.failure: The dynamic-probes suite proves the P5 local content-addressed hi/o cutoff toy, but this environment has no readable /etc/nix/machines entry and no verifiable ssh-ng remote builder for the P6 remote execution check.
phases.notes: Enable a genuine ssh-ng builder, then run the same CA toy body-edit, declaration-edit, and no-op build-count assertions through that remote store.

phases.title: Backpack unit ID and substitution lock fixture
phases.failure: The lock suite does not yet include a Backpack fixture proving stable unit IDs, hole substitutions, and instantiated unit references.
phases.notes: Add a committed golden lock fixture and convert this row to a measured comparison when the fixture is checked by repent.

phases.title: Per-target flag divergence lock fixture
phases.failure: The lock suite does not yet prove that package flags can diverge by target and still produce deterministic lock-local metadata.
phases.notes: Add a multi-target fixture with different flag selections and assert the generated lock graph.

phases.title: Cross-machine lock determinism
phases.failure: The lock suite only checks the committed benchmark lock on one machine; it does not yet prove byte-identical emission across machines and operating systems.
phases.notes: Add a multi-run lock fixture that records the compiler, OS, and normalized lock bytes for each runner.

phases.title: Wasm and pure-Nix lowerer equality
phases.failure: The eval layer does not yet prove that the Wasm lowerer and pure-Nix lowerer produce deepSeq-equal attrsets for committed lock fixtures.
phases.notes: Add golden equality fixtures for ordinary units, target divergence, and Backpack lock data once both lowerers exist.

phases.title: Development shell HLS projection
phases.failure: The dev shell now proves cabal build all avoids rebuilding external packages for the benchmark fixture, but the suite still lacks the HLS and multi-repl projection for Backpack-heavy development shells.
phases.notes: Add a projection smoke test that exposes indefinite and instantiated Backpack units to HLS or multi-repl without rebuilding external packages.

phases.title: Cache realisation and anchor fallback
phases.failure: The cache lane does not yet prove realisation round-trips through the binary cache or the fallback anchor path when content-addressed output support is unavailable.
phases.notes: Add cache upload/download checks and a fallback derivation path check.

phases.title: Dynamic derivation emission convergence
phases.notes: The penance target runs real ghc -M, emits the module dynamic derivation graph twice with nix derivation add, compares the emitted root drv text, enforces a sub-2s planner bound, builds the dyndrv executable, and compares its output with the lock-built unit executable. The haskell.nix target is the same benchmark executable baseline.

phases.title: Thirty-module incremental cutoff
phases.notes: Builds the committed thirty-module diamond fixture through the dyndrv module graph and compares it with a haskell.nix build of the same executable. Exact rebuild sets for body, export-shape, and no-op edits are enforced by rebuild-scenarios rows.

phases.title: hs-boot ordering and Template Haskell classification
phases.notes: The penance proof runs ghc -M and penance-plan on a committed fixture with a SOURCE-import cycle and a Template Haskell splice dependency, asserts the hs-boot node precedes the cycle, asserts the splice module is dbFull while the sibling and dependency are dbIface, and exposes the built dyndrv executable. The exact dependency-body rebuild behavior is enforced by the M4-hs-boot-th-dep-body-edit rebuild-scenarios row.

phases.title: Backpack body, type, and signature rebuild matrix
phases.failure: The Backpack suite builds a multi-instantiation fixture but does not yet prove rebuild scope for implementation body edits, type changes, and signature changes.
phases.notes: Add edit-class fixtures and assert the exact indefinite and instantiated units rebuilt.

phases.title: Backpack development projection
phases.failure: The suite does not yet prove that HLS and development projections can expose indefinite units and instantiated units in a usable shape.
phases.notes: Add an editor-oriented projection check once the lock graph exposes the required unit metadata.

phases.title: CUDA and hardware-in-loop cross smoke
phases.failure: There is no benchmark row for the CUDA or hardware-in-loop smoke path described by the cross-compilation milestone.
phases.notes: Add a small Accelerate or CUDA fixture and a gated hardware-in-loop runner that reports unavailable hardware as a failing capability row.

phases.title: MSC verify rejects corrupt bundles
phases.failure: The multi-system closure suite does not yet prove that msc verify rejects a corrupted NAR, manifest, or signature.
phases.notes: Add a negative verification fixture that mutates one artifact at a time.

phases.title: MSC installs in a NixOS VM without experimental features
phases.failure: The multi-system closure suite does not yet boot a NixOS VM and install the bundle with experimental features disabled.
phases.notes: Add a VM test that installs, verifies, and executes the bundled service closure.

phases.title: Warp VM deploy, swap, reconcile, and reboot
phases.failure: The warp suite writes a local manifest but does not yet prove Tier 0 deploy, Tier 1 service swap, reconcile, and reboot behavior in a VM.
phases.notes: Add a VM runner that records deploy timing, activation state, and post-reboot service identity.

phases.title: Warp production image guard
phases.failure: The warp suite does not yet prove that production images refuse unsafe swap or tainted service operations.
phases.notes: Add negative tests for production guard rails and record the rejected operations.

phases.title: Operational kill-switch matrix
phases.failure: The haskell.nix baseline suite now exercises the granularity switch through penanceProjectVariants, including byte-equal unit and module outputs from the same committed lock, but the total benchmark still lacks lowering, addressing, and cache-anchor switch coverage.
phases.notes: Keep this row failing until the remaining operational switches are covered by one matrix runner; the granularity axis is recorded in HN-project-variants-overrides.

phases.title: Nix version canary
phases.failure: The benchmark suite does not yet run a canary across supported Nix versions and feature-flag combinations.
phases.notes: Add a version matrix that validates the configured Nix binary before expensive suites run.

phases.title: Clean-store cold-builder benchmark lane
phases.failure: The benchmark suite does not yet run cold-path timings on a clean store or dedicated builder.
phases.notes: Add a CI-only lane that measures uncached evaluation, build, and closure realization behavior.

phases.title: No-op nix build timing and rebuild count
phases.failure: The rebuild-scenarios suite enforces a zero-rebuild bound for the lock-built penanceBenchViaLock executable, but no-op coverage does not yet include the haskell.nix side or the rest of the benchmark targets.
phases.notes: Extend the rebuild-scenarios harness coverage beyond penanceBenchViaLock before this gap row is removed or converted.

phases.title: Benchmark threshold gates
phases.failure: The total benchmark records timings but does not yet enforce configured pass/fail budgets for eval, build, rebuild, and closure-size regressions.
phases.notes: Add thresholds to the total runner summary and fail when a required budget is exceeded.

phases.title: Multi-package Hackage and Stackage corpus sweep
phases.failure: The total benchmark validates one Hackage package and one Stackage package by default, but does not yet sweep a representative multi-package corpus.
phases.notes: Add a curated corpus list with small, medium, Backpack, TH, test-suite, benchmark, and transitive-dependency cases.
